guidance.heading: Q4 2026 Expectations
section: •Total Contribution ex-TAC(1) to be between $227 million and $233 million
•Contribution ex-TAC(1) attributable to CTV to be between $124 million and $127 million
•Contribution ex-TAC(1) attributable to DV+ to be between $103 million and $106 million
•Adjusted EBITDA operating expenses(4) to be between $125 million and $127 million
•Raising total Contribution ex-TAC(1) growth to be approximately 17%, up from 13% to 14%
•Raising Adjusted EBITDA(1) percentage growth to be approximately 30%, from greater than 20%
•Raising Adjusted EBITDA margin(2) to be approximately 38.5%, from at least 37%
•Raising free cash flow(5) growth to be above 60%, from the high 40% range
•Total top-line growth of over 15%, excluding political and not including upside from Google remedies, or 10% on a total reported basis
